goals: Prevent exactly the Macaw's Trapdoors 1.1.5 ranch and bark families from culling neighboring solid faces through their intentionally open or transparent model regions under MoreCulling 1.8.1.
Preserve every Macaw registry identity, model, texture, blockstate property, placement and interaction behavior while leaving all unrelated trapdoors and MoreCulling behavior unchanged.
Remain compatible with the existing Interchangeable Block Families literal catalog without changing IBF membership or equivalence.
scope: Use MoreCulling 1.8.1's supported per-block MoreBlockCulling API to disable neighbor-face culling against a hard-coded set of 23 audited mcwtrpdoors registry IDs.

Cover all 11 registered ranch variants and all 12 registered bark variants in mcw-trapdoors-1.1.5-mc26.2fabric.jar; Bamboo contributes bark only because that provider does not register a bamboo_ranch_trapdoor block.
Fail closed on exact Macaw's Trapdoors 1.1.5 and MoreCulling 1.8.1 provider versions and verify the controlled provider bytes and API signatures during every build.

exclusions: No Macaw or MoreCulling JAR edits, bundled provider code/assets, model or resource overrides, registry or item ID changes, blockstate/property changes, geometry changes, textures, recipes, loot, sounds, collision, placement, interaction, opening, redstone, or broad trapdoor discovery.
No changes to Interchangeable Block Families, other projects, unrelated Macaw trapdoors, unrelated MoreCulling culling decisions, or any file under originals/.

The protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 gameplay instance is permanently out of scope; runtime deployment and validation may use only the serialized Test Instance Manager and dedicated Matcha Flavoured 26.2 Workbench.
